question: Do compounds inferred as binders from phase-one validation overlap chemically with the 39 organizer-released active-learning binders?
method: For each of the 8 logically forced phase-one validation positives and 628 forced negatives, calculate the maximum non-chiral ECFP4 Tanimoto similarity to any of the 39 released binders. Compare the similarity score as a discriminator on this small adaptive validation set.
limitation: Only eight positives can be inferred molecule-by-molecule from aggregate feedback. Their sample is adaptively selected and is not an independent transfer benchmark. The 39 released binders were also participant-selected from the blind test split; this audit does not estimate prevalence in validation or remaining test candidates.
